exclusion_detail: Lead 12b is made in 5 reactions from purchased 2,3-dichloro-1,4-naphthoquinone (Scheme 2): amination with 2-methoxyethylamine (8), N-acetylation (9), displacement with benzylamine (10a), HBr cyclisation to the 2-methylimidazolium (11a), then condensation with indole-3-carbaldehyde (12b).

lead.label: 12b
lead.why: Abstract: '12b, which showed potent cytotoxicity against the three tested cell lines with IC50 values in the range of 0.06-0.21 uM ... compound 12b was chosen for further in-depth studies' (also the in vivo compound).

notes: Series 7a-l (Scheme 1) needs 6 reactions (amination, acetylation, amine substitution, cyclisation, N-ethylation, aldehyde condensation) and its first two intermediates are 'known compounds prepared as previously published'; series 12a-g all share the 5-step route. Source: main text Scheme 2 and Experimental 4.2.2; no SI file.
